title: West Boundary Water Security
text:
Overview
Near-real-time surface-water monitoring for the West Boundary region. Daily mean discharge is pulled directly from the Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) real-time hydrometric web service via the tidyhydat R package.


Kettle River — Last 60 Days Live Telemetry








Methodology

Automated Hydrology: Current flow data is automatically retrieved from the ECCC real-time hydrometric API via the tidyhydat R package (parameter 47, discharge, in m³/s).
Spatial Data Integrity: Land classification (ALR parcels) can be queried directly from the BC Data Catalogue API using the bcdata R package, ensuring models always use the most authoritative and up-to-date regional boundaries.
